name: spotipw
spotifyglass_refresh: dylibs/spotifyglass.dylib is the clean Theos build of the migrated PwEevee product source tree at public version 3.1.6.1 (macOS builder, Xcode 27.1 / Theos 6e7b8c4, `make FINALPACKAGE=1 TARGET_CODESIGN=codesign TARGET_CODESIGN_FLAGS='--force --sign -'`). It carries the cold-cache customize gate: customize is answered from cache only when a non-empty rewritten body exists, so a cold cache lets the real fetch out to be patched on arrival. Source: source/tweak/Sources/Shared/AdBlock/AdNetwork.x (canReplayCustomize). This build also carries the AppIcon alternate-icon registry change (iOS 17-capable picker for the 30 brand icons); it recompiled the dylib, so the pinned size and hash were refreshed. It is ad-hoc signed with `codesign -f -s - -i spotifyglass.dylib` (flags=0x0) and links @rpath/CydiaSubstrate.framework/CydiaSubstrate (rootless). origin/origin_sha256 still describe the deb this component was first extracted from. The 304 replay path uses the same gate: replayFor only synthesises a 200 around a non-empty cached body and hands that validated body to the delegate, so an empty cache can no longer be replayed as a fabricated 200. Third pass: a customize 304 with nothing to replay is marked on the task and completed as Spotify sent it, so the completion path cannot turn it into a zero-byte 200 either; both replay paths (304 and cached block) log the byte count they actually delivered, which is what the on-device live test reads.
source_tree: source (migrated PwEevee product source; public version in source/public-version.txt, internal upstream line in source/version.txt)

implementation_guard.$comment: Strings that must (required) / must not (forbidden) appear in the pinned spotifyglass.dylib, so an old-lineage or stale artifact can never be packaged silently. unified.sh hard-fails on a mismatch before merging; dylib-guard-test.pl verifies the same spec. The legacy update key spotifyglass.update.taurus.latest is REQUIRED: it is the pinned migration alias that lets pre-rename installs move their cached release across.
